application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use - offices to dwellinghouses
description: Change of use application from Office Use Class B1 (a) to provide 232 residential units (Class C3).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - No development shall take place, including any works of demolition, until a Construction Logistics Plan has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The approved Plan shall be adhered to throughout the construction period. The Plan shall include:
i.              a site plan
ii.             confirmation that a pre-start record of site conditions on the adjoining public highway will be undertaken with Hounslow Highways and a commitment to repair any damage caused
iii.            provision for the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors 
iv.           provisions for loading, unloading and storage of plant and materials within the site
v.            details of access to the site, including means to control and manage access and egress of vehicles to and from the site for the duration of construction including phasing arrangements 
vi.           details of vehicle routeing from the site to the wider strategic road network
vii.          the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate 
viii.         provision of wheel washing facilities at the site exit and a commitment to sweep adjacent roads when required and at the request of the council
ix.           a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works
x.            appropriate vehicle routes to and from the site
xi.           measures to ensure the safety of all users of the public highway especially cyclists and pedestrians in the vicinity of the site and especially at the access
xii.          commitment to liaise with other contractors in the vicinity of the site to maximise the potential for consolidation and to minimise traffic impacts.
xiii.         avoidance of peak hours for deliveries and details of a booking system to avoid vehicles waiting on the public highway

Condition : 2 - No car parking shall take place except in the parking bays (including spaces for people with disabilities) as shown on detailed drawings to be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to first occupation of the units hereby approved.

Condition : 3 - No unit shall be occupied until details of cycle parking provision have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be installed prior to occupation and permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 4 - 4.	No unit shall be occupied until details of refuse and recycling storage have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be installed prior to occupation and permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 5 - 5.	Prior to first occupation of the units hereby approved details of a car parking management plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The management of the car park shall be undertaken in accordance with this plan thereafter.

Condition : 6 - 6.	Prior to first occupation of the units hereby approved details of delivering and servicing shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Deliveries and servicing shall thereafter be undertaken in accordance with these details.

Condition : 7 - 7.	Before the development hereby permitted is occupied, arrangements shall be agreed in writing with the local planning authority and be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a residents parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the Hounslow town Centre North at any time.

Condition : 8 - 8.	A travel plan shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of the development.  The measures contained in the Travel Plan shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 9 - 9.	Prior to first occupation of the units hereby approved electric vehicle charging points shall be installed in accordance with details to have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The charging points shall be retained permanently thereafter.
Condition : 10 - 10.	No loading or unloading on the public highway shall take place as a result of this scheme.
Condition : 11 - The development hereby permitted shall be completed before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
